proposed.text: Which official has SOLE authority under PD 1096 to approve or deny a change of use and occupancy application?

options.text: The DPWH Regional Director for all changes involving buildings of more than three storeys
The local Sangguniang Bayan or Sangguniang Panlungsod through a zoning resolution
The Building Official of the jurisdiction where the building is located
A joint committee of the BO, BFP Chief, and local health officer for changes involving public use

proposed.rationale: Sec. 702 vests sole authority for approving or denying change of use applications in the Building Official of the jurisdiction. This authority is not shared with DPWH regional offices, local legislative bodies, or inter-agency committees for standard occupancy changes. The BO applies the Code requirements to determine compliance and exercises the approval authority independently.
proposed.explanation: The BO = sole authority for occupancy change approvals. This mirrors the BO's authority for building permits (Sec. 301) and certificates of occupancy (Sec. 309). The BO is the single point of accountability for all building Code enforcement decisions at the local level.
